svg.title: Watin Promfiy — AI Engineer · Data Scientist · Data Engineer
svg.desc: Pixel-art JRPG title screen at dusk: a knight, a dwarf tinkerer and a young mage with a glowing orb stand on a road that leads past a BKK / TOKYO signpost toward a distant castle, while a small mint dragon flies overhead. A message window types: AI Engineer at Asia Energy Tech shipping LLM agents to production; skills LLMs, RAG, multi-agent systems and knowledge graphs; 6 papers accepted in 2026, 5 first-author, and 3 hackathon wins; next stop Tokyo, KMITL to Musashino University.
